repos.rationale: The ticket explicitly states 'This ticket is only for NSGM.' All implementation work — the approval flow, single-execution profile switching, and write-operation detection — belongs in ns-gm. The three-layer architecture (CLI → proxy → RESTlet) provides clear intercept points for each piece.

Included for research purposes only. Provides reference patterns for credential materialization (decrypt → temp file → use → scrub), ns-gm CLI invocation (setup:ci, init, env), and per-step credential environment selection. No code changes needed in this repo for the current ticket.
